say:8:1010504005:0.source_cn: 这是什么很稀罕的魔法吗？

say:10:1010504007:0.source_cn: 如果是我，就算用一生去钻研它也无法掌握。

say:11:1010504008:0.text: That's selective, even by magical standards.

say:16:1010504011:0.text: There's a hidden cave somewhere at the foot of the mountains to the northeast.
